resolved_conflicts.explanation: The undated Register page says the tower is active during fire season. WPSU and Allegheny Front (May 2019) say it is no longer in use but still standing. The story follows the 2019 reports as the more recent account; the Register text may be out of date.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1921 build date, 18.3 m height and Clearfield/Moshannon location are supported by NHLR and GantNews. Status conflict is the main open point: NHLR (undated) says active in fire season, while WPSU and Allegheny Front (May 2019) say no longer in use; the story follows 2019. No access source found, so no access key is recorded and the brief's access 'unknown' stands. No fire history found in the sources read. The NHLR photo credit (Ron Stafford) has no image URL, so no photo is added. A 2026 check of the current condition would need a source newer than 2019.
